title: 第一卷 正文第17章 购买丹方第一卷 正文第18章 新生入学大典
content_zh:
管事眼睛微微一亮，一品高阶丹方还处在基础丹方的范畴中，价格并不高。
但二品以上的丹方，就需要炼丹师耗费灵魂力量，用特殊法门制作而成。丹方的品阶越高，价格就越高。
管事介绍道：“我风云城珍宝阁内，共有一品高阶丹方三十六种、二品低阶丹方二十二种，二品中阶丹方十二种。这是丹方目录，请您阅览。”
说着，管事右手翻转，从储物玉佩中取出一本精致的册子，双手递给楚凌天。
楚凌天接过册子，翻阅起来。
珍宝阁不愧是赤炎帝国最大的商行，仅仅一个风云城分阁，就售卖着如此多的丹方，不论是疗伤类、精进修为类，还是像燃血丹那样的突然提升修为类的丹药，全都有，种类众多。
楚凌天沉思了片刻后，在册子中选中了三种丹药：“我要玄气丹丹方、复伤丹丹方和灵武丹丹方。”
三种丹方中，玄气丹是一品高阶丹药，可以加快修士的修炼速度。
复伤丹是疗伤类的二品低阶丹药。
灵武丹是二品中阶丹药，同样可以加快修士的修炼速度。
楚浩辰就是靠着主家赐下的灵武丹，在短时间内，从灵者九重天初期突破至灵师一重天初期。
管事开价道：“玄气丹丹方一千两、复伤丹丹方五千两、灵武丹丹方两万两，一共是两万六千两。”
楚凌天点了点头，幸亏得到了楚江的全部身家。不然想要凑齐两万六千两，还不知道要多久。
“一份炼制蕴气丹所需的药材的种子，需要多少钱？”楚凌天问道。
珍宝阁作为赤炎帝国最大的商行，生意范围广泛，不光卖丹药、药材，同样也卖药材种子。
管事答道：“蕴气丹是一品中阶丹药，炼制它需要三种普通的一品药材。其种子的价值不高，一份种子只需要三两银子。”
楚凌天点了点头，继续问道：“那一份炼制玄气丹、复伤丹、灵武丹，所需的药材的种子，分别是多少钱？”
管事答道：“一份炼制玄气丹所需的药材的种子，售价十两。一份炼制复伤丹所需的药材的种子，售价二十两。一份炼制灵武丹所需的药材的种子，售价五十两。”
楚凌天暗暗咋舌。
他原本多买些药材种子，种在宝塔第一层空间内。却没想到，光是种子就这么贵。

“灵武丹是二品中阶丹药，距离我还太远，炼制它所需的药材的种子就先不买了。先把精力放在蕴气丹、玄气丹和复伤丹上。”
楚凌天思索了片刻后，对着管事说道：“除了三种丹方外，我还要一千份炼制蕴气丹丹所需的药材的种子，一千份炼制玄气丹丹所需的药材的种子，八百份炼制复伤丹所需的药材的种子。”
管事道：“药材种子共两万九千两，加上三种丹药，一共是五万五千两。”
正好将楚凌天的身上的银票全部花完。
管事接过楚凌天递来的银票，提醒道：“一品药材的种子，想要培育成熟，需要一两年的时间。而二品药材的种子，想要培育成熟，则需要三年五载的时间，耗时比较长。您作为炼丹师，若是着急提升炼丹水平，我建议还是直接成熟的药材比较好。”
楚凌天道：“没事，我有的是时间。”
他当然知道，直接用成熟的药材更好。但那将是一笔巨额的开销，他可没有那么钱。
虽然从种子开始培育，十分耗费时间。但有混沌宝塔在，他最不缺的就是时间。
content_en:
The steward's eyes lit up slightly. The first-grade high-end elixir recipe was still in the category of basic elixir recipe, and the price was not high.
But second-grade and above elixir recipes require the alchemist to expend soul power and use special techniques to make them. The higher the grade of the Danfang, the higher the price.
The steward introduced: "In my Fengyun City Treasure Pavilion, there are thirty-six kinds of first-grade high-level elixirs, twenty-two kinds of second-grade low-level elixirs, and twelve kinds of second-grade mid-level elixirs. This is the catalog of elixirs, please read it."
With that said, the steward turned his right hand, took out an exquisite booklet from the storage jade pendant, and handed it to Chu Lingtian with both hands.
Chu Lingtian took the booklet and started reading it.
Zhenbao Pavilion is indeed the largest trading house in the Scarlet Flame Empire. Just one branch of Fengyun City sells so many elixirs, whether they are healing elixirs, improving cultivation, or elixirs that can suddenly improve cultivation like the Blood-Burning Pill, there are all kinds of them.
After Chu Lingtian pondered for a moment, he selected three elixirs in the booklet: "I want the Xuanqi elixir, the recovery elixir and the Lingwu elixir."
Among the three elixir prescriptions, the Xuanqi elixir is a first-grade high-level elixir that can speed up a monk's practice.
The Rejuvenation Pill is a second-grade low-level elixir for healing injuries.
Lingwu Dan is a second-grade mid-level elixir that can also speed up a monk's practice.
Chu Haochen relied on the Lingwu Pill given by his master to break through from the early stage of the ninth level of spiritual master to the early stage of the first level of spiritual master in a short period of time.
The steward quoted the price: "One thousand taels of Xuanqi elixir, five thousand taels of recovery elixir, and twenty thousand taels of Lingwu elixir. The total is twenty-six thousand taels."
Chu Lingtian nodded, fortunately he got Chu Jiang's entire net worth. Otherwise, I don’t know how long it will take to collect 26,000 taels.
"How much does it cost to refine the seeds of the medicinal materials needed to refine the Qi-Yun Dan?" Chu Lingtian asked.
As the largest trading house in the Chiyan Empire, Zhenbao Pavilion has a wide range of business, not only selling elixirs and medicinal materials, but also medicinal seeds.
The steward replied: "Yunqi Pill is a first-grade mid-level elixir. Three common first-grade medicinal materials are needed to refine it. Its seeds are not of high value. One seed only costs three taels of silver."
Chu Lingtian nodded and continued to ask: "How much are the seeds of the medicinal materials needed to refine the Xuanqi Pill, the Rejuvenation Pill, and the Lingwu Pill?"
The steward replied: "A seed of medicinal materials required for refining Xuan Qi Pill costs ten taels. A seed of medicinal materials required for refining Injury Pill costs twenty taels. A seed of medicinal materials required for refining Lingwu Dan costs fifty taels."
Chu Lingtian was secretly speechless.
He originally bought some more medicinal seeds and planted them on the first floor of the pagoda. But I didn’t expect that the seeds alone were so expensive.
"Lingwu Dan is a second-grade mid-level elixir. It's still too far away from me, so I won't buy the seeds of the medicinal materials needed to refine it. I will focus on Yunqi Dan, Xuanqi Dan and Reinjury Dan first."
After Chu Lingtian thought for a moment, he said to the steward: "In addition to the three kinds of elixirs, I also want a thousand seeds of medicinal materials needed to refine Qi-Yun Dan, a thousand seeds of medicinal materials needed to refine Xuanqi Dan, and eight hundred seeds of medicinal materials needed to refine Reinjury Dan."
The steward said: "There are twenty-nine thousand taels of medicinal seeds, plus three kinds of elixirs, the total is fifty-five thousand taels."
Just in time to spend all the banknotes on Chu Lingtian's body.
The steward took the banknote handed over by Chu Lingtian and reminded: "It takes one or two years for the seeds of first-grade medicinal materials to be cultivated and mature. However, it takes three to five years to cultivate and mature the seeds of second-grade medicinal materials, which is relatively long. As an alchemist, if you are anxious to improve your alchemy level, I suggest that it is better to use directly mature medicinal materials."
Chu Lingtian said: "It's okay, I have plenty of time."
Of course he knew that it would be better to use mature medicinal materials directly. But that would be a huge expense, and he didn't have that kind of money.
Although growing it from seed is very time consuming. But there is the Pagoda of Chaos,The last thing he lacks is time.
